Sri.Ravi B.Patil., learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri.Veeranagouda Malipatil., learned HCGP for respondents 1 to 3 and Sri.Gourish S.Khashampur., learned counsel for respondent No.4 have appeared in person.
2. It appears that the petitioner is the absolute owner in possession of land bearing Sy.No.43/*/1/1 measuring to an extent of 01 Acre situated at Village Ganeshpurwadi, Bhalki Taluk, Bidar District.

The grievance of the petitioner is that under the guise of acquisition of the land, respondents 1 to 3 have made use of the land of the petitioner and neither they have initiated acquisition proceedings nor they have paid the compensation to the petitioner.

Contending that the inaction on the part of the respondent Authority to initiate appropriate proceedings to acquire the extent of land utilized for "Ashraya Yojane Scheme" is arbitrary and illegal, the petitioner has NC: 2024:KHC-K:567 invoked the Writ jurisdiction under Articles 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner and the respondents have urged several contentions.

Heard,
the contentions urged on behalf of the respective parties and perused the Writ papers with utmost care.
4. Sri.Ravi B.Patil., learned counsel for the petitioner in presenting his arguments submits that the petitioner would submit a representation putting forth his grievance to respondents 1 to 3.
Counsel therefore, submits that a direction may be issued to respondents 1 to 3 to consider the representation and act in accordance with the law.

By way of reply to this contention, learned HCGP appearing for respondents 1 to 3 submits that if such a representation is submitted by the petitioner, respondents 1 to 3 would consider the said representation and take action in accordance with the law.

sentences.text: The oral submission made by learned counsel for the respective parties is placed on record.
The petitioner is directed to submit a representation to respondents 1 to 3 within four weeks from today.
If such a representation is made, respondents 1 to 3 are directed to consider the representation and take action in accordance with the law, within three months thereon.
Needless to observe that this Court has not expressed any opinion on the merits of the case.
5. Resultantly, the Writ Petition is disposed of.
